abstract_sentences.text: Gene expression prediction, which predicts mRNA expression levels from DNA sequences, presents significant challenges.

evidence.anchor: Gene expression prediction presents significant challenges

abstract_sentences.text: Previous works often focus on extending input sequence length to locate distal enhancers, which may influence target genes from hundreds of kilobases away.

evidence.anchor: extending input sequence length to locate distal enhancers

abstract_sentences.text: Our work first reveals that for current models, long sequence modeling can decrease performance.

evidence.anchor: long sequence modeling can decrease performance

abstract_sentences.text: Even carefully designed algorithms only mitigate the performance degradation caused by long sequences.
Instead, we find that proximal multimodal epigenomic signals near target genes prove more essential.

evidence.anchor: proximal multimodal epigenomic signals near target genes

abstract_sentences.text: Hence we focus on how to better integrate these signals, which has been overlooked.

We find that different signal types serve distinct biological roles, with some directly marking active regulatory elements while others reflect background chromatin patterns that may introduce confounding effects.

evidence.anchor: different signal types serve distinct biological roles

abstract_sentences.text: Simple concatenation may lead models to develop spurious associations with these background patterns.

evidence.anchor: Simple concatenation may lead models to develop spurious associations

abstract_sentences.text: To address this challenge, we propose Prism, a framework that learns multiple combinations of high-dimensional epigenomic features to represent distinct background chromatin states and uses backdoor adjustment to mitigate confounding effects.

evidence.anchor: uses backdoor adjustment to mitigate confounding effects

abstract_sentences.text: Our experimental results demonstrate that proper modeling of multimodal epigenomic signals achieves state-of-the-art performance using only short sequences for gene expression prediction.

evidence.anchor: state-of-the-art performance using only short sequences

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 gene-expression prediction 的优化重点从继续扩展 DNA sequence length 转到短 proximal context 中区分并整合 multimodal epigenomic signals；signal-drop paradox 提供 confounding 动机，Prism 用 gene-wise latent background states、backdoor averaging 和 diversity regularization 回应。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figure 1/2、SCM、Prism architecture、Eqs. (1)-(5)、数据/基线/指标/切分、Table 1/2/3 和 Figure 5，足以呈现动机、方法和主比较。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整长度与 signal ablations、raw signal-drop、pretraining、extra signals、cross-cell、H1、dropout、prevalence/case study 和实现细节移入 Appendix B-L；正文紧凑，但 causal/robustness 证据需跨附录追踪。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 的悖论诊断接 SCM/architecture，再接 Eqs. (2)-(5) 和 Table 1/2/3，形成生物问题、因果机制、优化目标、决策结果的短链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: causal language 超过可识别证据：C 无 ground-truth state，uniform prior 与 X-H independence 未验证，representation averaging 仅在线性 head 下等价；基线引用、缺少 inferential tests、Table 2/7 分歧也限制 SOTA 强度。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 长上下文是核心路线时，先在 matched settings 做输入缩短与模态删除对照；引入 latent-causal state 时同步提供 state validation、替代解释对照和一致的重复/不确定性处理。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于有 proximal multimodal proxies、长程依赖和观测性 signal confounding 的 genomic/sequence-to-function 任务；短 context 性能不能单独证明 distal biology 不重要，latent weight structure 也不等于 causal identification。
